# Axial Skyrmions
- The reflection operation changes the sign of only one pion field, resulting in a relative phase definition that differs by π from refs.[3, 12, 7], where the antiSkyrmion requires changing signs of all three pion fields.
- This definition provides a more natural comparison with the analogous situation for monopoles.
- The profile function equals zero at radius s/2 from the Skyrmion (or antiSkyrmion) center (3.10), allowing continuous patching of Skyrmion and antiSkyrmion with vacuum fields outside the cores.
- Beyond the simple ansatz (3.7) initial conditions, more sophisticated initial conditions were implemented using the rational map ansatz [11] with an axially symmetric charge n map.
